consequences: Breaking for `sati decision delete`, so the changeset is minor. Until the board task lands, the board's Delete button on a decision returns 404.
context: A deleted decision stopped protecting the feature it lists, because the guard reads only undeleted decisions. `sati decision delete|restore` and the board routes allowed that. `feature` was in SOFT but no caller reached it, and deleteRecord already refused a shipped feature.
decision: Remove "decision" and "feature" from SOFT in core records.ts. Remove `sati decision delete` and `restore` and the board API routes. To change a decision, record a new one with --supersedes. `decision show` and recall now say "Superseded by <title>". Decisions already deleted stay deleted, and their tombstones import as before.
title: Decisions cannot be deleted; features leave the soft-delete list (review 10.1, 10.3)
